title: Kaikeyi's harsh words
introduction: In this chapter Rama arrives at the king's presence. Seeing King disturbed, Rama becomes grieved and wants to know the cause of king's perturbance. Queen Kaikeyi describes to Rama about the boons that Dasaratha had given earlier and also her wishes of coronating Bharatha instead of Rama and sending Rama to Dandaka forest. On listening to these harsh words of Kaikeyi, Rama did not become sorrowful, but Dasaratha was very much disturbed.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशः सर्गः ||
Thus completes the eighteenth sarga of Ayodhya kanda of Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
स ददर्श आसने रामः निषण्णम् पितरम् शुभे |
कैकेयी सहितम् दीनम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता
verses.iast:
sa dadarśa āsane rāmaḥ niṣaṇṇam pitaram śubhe |
kaikeyī sahitam dīnam mukhena pariśuṣyatā
verses.translation: Rama saw his father sitting on a beautiful seat, but with his face looking completely parched up and miserable. Kaikeyi was at his side.

verses.devanagari:
स पितुः चरणौ पूर्वम् अभिवाद्य विनीतवत् |
ततः ववन्दे चरणौ कैकेय्याः सुसमाहितः
verses.iast:
sa pituḥ caraṇau pūrvam abhivādya vinītavat |
tataḥ vavande caraṇau kaikeyyāḥ susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Rama being humble and well composed, first reverentially saluted his father's feet and then saluted Kaikeyi's feet.

verses.devanagari:
राम इति उक्त्वा च वचनम् वाष्प पर्याकुल ईक्षणः |
शशाक न्ऱ्पतिर् दीनो न ईक्षितुम् न अभिभाषितुम्
verses.iast:
rāma iti uktvā ca vacanam vāṣpa paryākula īkṣaṇaḥ |
śaśāka nRpatir dīno na īkṣitum na abhibhāṣitum
verses.translation: Dasaratha spoke only one word "Rama!" with his eyes filled with tears and dejected, being not able to see or to talk any further words.

glosses.meaning: with his eyes filled with tears

verses.devanagari:
तत् अपूर्वम् नर पतेर् द्ऱ्ष्ट्वा रूपम् भय आवहम् |
रामः अपि भयम् आपन्नः पदा स्प्ऱ्ष्ट्वा इव पन्नगम्
verses.iast:
tat apūrvam nara pater dRṣṭvā rūpam bhaya āvaham |
rāmaḥ api bhayam āpannaḥ padā spRṣṭvā iva pannagam
verses.translation: Having not seen earlier such a fearful form of his father, even Rama was frightened as though he seized a snake by his foot.

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रियैः अप्रह्ऱ्ष्टैअः तम् शोक सम्ताप कर्शितम् |
निह्श्वसन्तम् महा राजम् व्यथित आकुल चेतसम्
ऊर्मि मालिनम् अक्षोभ्यम् क्षुभ्यन्तम् इव सागरम् |
उपप्लुतम् इव आदित्यम् उक्त अन्ऱ्तम् ऱ्षिम् यथा
verses.iast:
indriyaiḥ aprahRṣṭaiaḥ tam śoka samtāpa karśitam |
nihśvasantam mahā rājam vyathita ākula cetasam
ūrmi mālinam akṣobhyam kṣubhyantam iva sāgaram |
upaplutam iva ādityam ukta anRtam Rṣim yathā
verses.translation: That king Dasaratha was sighing heavily with senses sans pleasure, emaciated with grief and anguish, with distressed and agitated mind, like ocean which cannot be perturbed, becoming perturbed with row of waves, like sun which is eclipsed and who lost lustre like by a sage who spoke untruth.

verses.devanagari:
अचिन्त्य कल्पम् हि पितुस् तम् शोकम् उपधारयन् |
बभूव सम्रब्धतरः समुद्रैव पर्वणि
verses.iast:
acintya kalpam hi pitus tam śokam upadhārayan |
babhūva samrabdhataraḥ samudraiva parvaṇi
verses.translation: Contemplating over the unimaginable sorrow of the king, he was very much perturbed as an ocean does on a full moon day.

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तयाम् आस च तदा रामः पित्ऱ् हिते रतः |
किंस्विद् अद्य एव न्ऱ्पतिर् न माम् प्रत्यभिनन्दति
verses.iast:
cintayām āsa ca tadā rāmaḥ pitR hite rataḥ |
kiṃsvid adya eva nRpatir na mām pratyabhinandati
verses.translation: The ingenious Rama, who is fond of his father's welfare, anxiously thought : " why indeed the king is not greeting me in return just today?"

verses.devanagari:
अन्यदा माम् पिता द्ऱ्ष्ट्वा कुपितः अपि प्रसीदति |
तस्य माम् अद्य सम्प्रेक्ष्य किम् आयासः प्रवर्तते
verses.iast:
anyadā mām pitā dRṣṭvā kupitaḥ api prasīdati |
tasya mām adya samprekṣya kim āyāsaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: "At other times, the father, even though angry used to be gracious after seeing me why today such a father has become weary after seeing me?"

verses.devanagari:
स दीनैव शोक आर्तः विषण्ण वदन द्युतिः |
कैकेयीम् अभिवाद्य एव रामः वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa dīnaiva śoka ārtaḥ viṣaṇṇa vadana dyutiḥ |
kaikeyīm abhivādya eva rāmaḥ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Rama indeed distressed and afflicted with grief, with lustre faded from his face, offered his salutation to Kaikeyi and spoke these words.

glosses.meaning: with lustre reduced from his face

verses.devanagari:
कच्चिन् मया न अपराधम् अज्ञानात् येन मे पिता |
कुपितः तन् मम आचक्ष्व त्वम् चैव एनम् प्रसादय
verses.iast:
kaccin mayā na aparādham aGYānāt yena me pitā |
kupitaḥ tan mama ācakṣva tvam caiva enam prasādaya
verses.translation: "I hope that I have not done anything wrong through ignorance. Tell me why father is angry with me. You alone propitiate him in my favour."

glosses.meaning: I hope that no wrong was done

verses.devanagari:
अप्रसन्नमनाः किम् नु सदा मां प्रति वत्सलः |
विवर्ण वदनो दीनो न हि माम् अभिभाषते
verses.iast:
aprasannamanāḥ kim nu sadā māṃ prati vatsalaḥ |
vivarṇa vadano dīno na hi mām abhibhāṣate
verses.translation: "Why my father, who was always affectionate to me, has become displeased? With his face becoming pale and dejected, he is not talking to me."

verses.devanagari:
शारीरः मानसो वा अपि कच्चित् एनम् न बाधते |
सम्तापो वा अभितापो वा दुर्लभम् हि सदा सुखम्
verses.iast:
śārīraḥ mānaso vā api kaccit enam na bādhate |
samtāpo vā abhitāpo vā durlabham hi sadā sukham
verses.translation: "I hope that either bodily affliction or mental distress is not troubling him. The object of happiness is indeed difficult to be attained always!"

glosses.meaning: is indeed difficult to be attained

verses.devanagari:
कच्चिन् न किंचित् भरते कुमारे प्रिय दर्शने |
शत्रुघ्ने वा महा सत्त्वे मात्ऱ्ऱ्णाम् वा मम अशुभम्
verses.iast:
kaccin na kiṃcit bharate kumāre priya darśane |
śatrughne vā mahā sattve mātRRṇām vā mama aśubham
verses.translation: "I hope that no bad thing occurred to Bharata, the delightful man to look at or to Shatrughna, the man of great strength or to my mother. "

glosses.meaning: I hope no bad thing occured
the delightful man to look at

verses.devanagari:
अतोषयन् महा राजम् अकुर्वन् वा पितुर् वचः |
मुहूर्तम् अपि न इच्चेयम् जीवितुम् कुपिते न्ऱ्पे
verses.iast:
atoṣayan mahā rājam akurvan vā pitur vacaḥ |
muhūrtam api na icceyam jīvitum kupite nRpe
verses.translation: "If our father becomes angry, I do not desire to live even for a moment without satisfying him or without fulfilling his command."

verses.devanagari:
यतः मूलम् नरः पश्येत् प्रादुर्भावम् इह आत्मनः |
कथम् तस्मिन् न वर्तेत प्रत्यक्षे सति दैवते
verses.iast:
yataḥ mūlam naraḥ paśyet prādurbhāvam iha ātmanaḥ |
katham tasmin na varteta pratyakṣe sati daivate
verses.translation: "Man sees father as the visible god who is the root cause of one's own coming into existence and how else can he behave towards him other than like that?"

verses.devanagari:
कच्चित् ते परुषम् किंचित् अभिमानात् पिता मम |
उक्तः भवत्या कोपेन यत्र अस्य लुलितम् मनः
verses.iast:
kaccit te paruṣam kiṃcit abhimānāt pitā mama |
uktaḥ bhavatyā kopena yatra asya lulitam manaḥ
verses.translation: "I hope you have not spoken anything which hurt my father's conscience with your pride and anger."

glosses.meaning: i hope my father has been spoken

verses.devanagari:
एतत् आचक्ष्व मे देवि तत्त्वेन परिप्ऱ्च्चतः |
किम् निमित्तम् अपूर्वो अयम् विकारः मनुज अधिपे
verses.iast:
etat ācakṣva me devi tattvena paripRccataḥ |
kim nimittam apūrvo ayam vikāraḥ manuja adhipe
verses.translation: "I am asking you why my father got this perturbation, which was not there earlier. Tell me the true position."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी राघवेण महात्मना |
उवाचेदं सुनिर्लज्जा धृष्टमात्महितं वचः
verses.iast:
evamuktā tu kaikeyī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā |
uvācedaṃ sunirlajjā dhṛśhṭamātmahitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Thus questioned by the great souled Rama, Kaikeyi fearlessly spoke these words for her own benefit, without any shame on her part.

verses.devanagari:
न राजा कुपितो राम व्यसनम् नास्य किंचन |
किंचिन्मनोगतं त्वस्य त्वद्भयान्नाभिभाषते
verses.iast:
na rājā kupito rāma vyasanam nāsya kiṃcana |
kiṃcinmanogataṃ tvasya tvadbhayānnābhibhāśhate
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! The king is not angry. There is nothing of distress for him. But he has something in mind which he is not telling from fear."

glosses.meaning: there is nothing of vyasanam = distress
there is something manogatham = in mind

verses.devanagari:
प्रियम् त्वामप्रियम् वक्तुम् वाणी नास्योपपर्तते |
तदवश्यम् त्वया कार्यम् यदनेनाश्रुतम् मम
verses.iast:
priyam tvāmapriyam vaktum vāṇī nāsyopapartate |
tadavaśyam tvayā kāryam yadanenāśrutam mama
verses.translation: "To him, words are not coming off to tell disagreeable utterance to you, the dear one. He promised me a word. It is to be certainly done by you."

verses.devanagari:
एष मह्यम् वरम् दत्त्वा पुरा मामभिपूज्य च |
स पश्चात्तप्यते राजा यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा
verses.iast:
eśha mahyam varam dattvā purā māmabhipūjya ca |
sa paścāttapyate rājā yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā
verses.translation: "Long ago, the king honoured me and gave me a boon. Like a common man, he is repenting now for having given the boon."

verses.devanagari:
अतिसृज्य ददानीति वरम् मम विशाम्पतिः |
स निरर्थं गतजले सेतुम् बन्धितुमिच्छति
verses.iast:
atisṛjya dadānīti varam mama viśāmpatiḥ |
sa nirarthaṃ gatajale setum bandhitumicchati
verses.translation: "This king promised me to give the boon and now he desires to build a dam wastefully on a place where water has gone away."

glosses.meaning: on a place where water has gone away.

verses.devanagari:
धर्मूलमिदम् राम विदितम् च सतामपि |
तत्सत्यम् न त्यजेद्राजा कुपितस्त्वत्कृते यथा
verses.iast:
dharmūlamidam rāma viditam ca satāmapi |
tatsatyam na tyajedrājā kupitastvatkṛte yathā
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! It is known by even wise men, that truth is the root of righteousness. See that the offended king does not abandon such a truth for your sake."

verses.devanagari:
यदि तद्वक्ष्यते राजा शुभम् वा यदि वाऽशुभम् |
करिष्यसि ततः सर्वमाख्यामि पुनस्त्वहम्
verses.iast:
yadi tadvakśyate rājā śubham vā yadi vā'śubham |
kariśhyasi tataḥ sarvamākhyāmi punastvaham
verses.translation: "The king is about to mention that truth which may look auspicious or inauspicious to you. Still, I shall tell you all that, if you shall do it afterwards."

verses.devanagari:
यदि त्वभिहितं राज्ञा त्वयि तन्न विपत्स्यते |
ततोऽहमभिधास्यामि न ह्येष त्वयि वक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
yadi tvabhihitaṃ rājJṇā tvayi tanna vipatsyate |
tato'hamabhidhāsyāmi na hyeśha tvayi vakśyati
verses.translation: "If what is spoken by the king does not create unfavourableness in you, I shall then tell you. This king will not indeed tell you."

verses.devanagari:
एतात्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या समुदाहृतम् |
उवाच व्यथितो रामस्ताम् देवीम् नृपसन्निधौ
verses.iast:
etāttu vacanaṃ śrutvā kaikeyyā samudāhṛtam |
uvāca vyathito rāmastām devīm nṛpasannidhau
verses.translation: After hearing the words of Kaikeyi, Rama felt painful and spoke thus to her in the presence of the king.

glosses.meaning: in the presence of the king.

verses.devanagari:
अहो धिङ्नार्हसे देवि पक्तुं मामीदृशं वचः |
अहम् हि वचनात् राज्ञः पतेयम् अपि पावके
भक्षयेयम् विषम् तीक्ष्णम् मज्जेयम् अपि च अर्णवे |
नियुक्तः गुरुणा पित्रा न्ऱ्पेण च हितेन च
verses.iast:
aho dhiṇ^nārhase devi paktuṃ māmīdṛśaṃ vacaḥ |
aham hi vacanāt rāGYaḥ pateyam api pāvake
bhakṣayeyam viṣam tīkṣṇam majjeyam api ca arṇave |
niyuktaḥ guruṇā pitrā nRpeṇa ca hitena ca
verses.translation: "Oh, queen! what a pity! Do not talk like that to me. If father tells me, I shall jump even in fire. If father, who is a king, who wishes my welfare and who is venerable, commands me, I shall eat fiery poison and shall sink into an ocean."

glosses.meaning: what a pity! naarhasi = you are not worthy

verses.devanagari:
तत् ब्रूहि वचनम् देवि राज्ञो यद् अभिकान्क्षितम् |
करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामः द्विर् न अभिभाषते
verses.iast:
tat brūhi vacanam devi rāGYo yad abhikānkṣitam |
kariṣye pratijāne ca rāmaḥ dvir na abhibhāṣate
verses.translation: "Oh queen! Tell me the words of the king as desired by him. I even promise to do it. Rama does not speak two things."

verses.devanagari:
तम् आर्जव समायुक्तम् अनार्या सत्य वादिनम् |
उवाच रामम् कैकेयी वचनम् भ्ऱ्श दारुणम्
verses.iast:
tam ārjava samāyuktam anāryā satya vādinam |
uvāca rāmam kaikeyī vacanam bhRśa dāruṇam
verses.translation: That vulgar Kaikeyi uttered very cruel words to that Rama, who was committed to sincerity and speaking of truth.

glosses.meaning: and speaking of truth and a great war.

verses.devanagari:
पुरा देव असुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव |
रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महा रणे
verses.iast:
purā deva asure yuddhe pitrā te mama rāghava |
rakṣitena varau dattau saśalyena mahā raṇe
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! During a battle and a great war between celestials and demons long ago, I protected your father who was pierced by darts. Then, he gave me two boons."

verses.devanagari:
तत्र मे याचितः राजा भरतस्य अभिषेचनम् |
गमनम् दण्डक अरण्ये तव च अद्य एव राघव
verses.iast:
tatra me yācitaḥ rājā bharatasya abhiṣecanam |
gamanam daṇḍaka araṇye tava ca adya eva rāghava
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! According to those boons, I asked the king for coronation of Bharata and for your going to Dandaka forest today itself."

verses.devanagari:
यदि सत्य प्रतिज्ञम् त्वम् पितरम् कर्तुम् इच्चसि |
आत्मानम् च नर रेष्ठ मम वाक्यम् इदम् श्ऱ्णु
verses.iast:
yadi satya pratiGYam tvam pitaram kartum iccasi |
ātmānam ca nara reṣṭha mama vākyam idam śRṇu
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! If you want to make yourself and your father faithful to a promise, listen to these words of mine.

glosses.itrans: the best of men! tvam ichchhasi yadi
glosses.iast: the best of men! tvam icchasi yadi
glosses.devanagari: थे बेस्त् ओf मेन्! त्वं इच्च्हसि यदि

glosses.meaning: listen to idam vaakyam = these words

verses.devanagari:
स निदेशे पितुस् तिष्ठ यथा तेन प्रतिश्रुतम् |
त्वया अरण्यम् प्रवेष्टव्यम् नव वर्षाणि पन्च च
verses.iast:
sa nideśe pitus tiṣṭha yathā tena pratiśrutam |
tvayā araṇyam praveṣṭavyam nava varṣāṇi panca ca
verses.translation: "Abide by your father's command. As per his assurance, you have to stay in the forest for fourteen years."

glosses.meaning: is to be occupied for navapanchacha = faourteen

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्त्वभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचन्म् |
त्वदर्थे विहितम् राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव
verses.iast:
bharatastvabhiśhicyeta yadetadabhiśhecanm |
tvadarthe vihitam rājJṇā tena sarveṇa rāghava
verses.translation: "Bharata is to be enthroned with the use of complete collection of materials already arranged by the king for your sake."

verses.devanagari:
सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि दण्डक अरण्यम् आश्रितः |
अभिषेकम् इमम् त्यक्त्वा जटा चीर धरः वस
verses.iast:
sapta sapta ca varṣāṇi daṇḍaka araṇyam āśritaḥ |
abhiṣekam imam tyaktvā jaṭā cīra dharaḥ vasa
verses.translation: "You have to leave this coronation function and dwell in the forest of Dandaka for fourteen years, wearing braided hair and covered with a hide."

glosses.meaning: taking refuge in the forest of Dandaka
wearing braided hari and covered with a hide.

verses.devanagari:
भरतः कोसल पुरे प्रशास्तु वसुधाम् इमाम् |
नाना रत्न समाकीर्णम् सवाजि रथ कुन्जराम्
verses.iast:
bharataḥ kosala pure praśāstu vasudhām imām |
nānā ratna samākīrṇam savāji ratha kunjarām
verses.translation: "Let Bharata rule this earth, by residing in Ayodhya filled with various types of precious thing together with horses, chariots and elephants."

glosses.meaning: completely covered with various types of precious things

verses.devanagari:
एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोयम् कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः |
शोकसंक्लिष्टवदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम्
verses.iast:
etena tvāṃ narendroyam kāruṇyena samāplutaḥ |
śokasaṅkliśhṭavadano na śaknoti nirīkśitum
verses.translation: "For this reason, king Dasaratha who is overwhelmed with sympathy towards you is not able to see you with his face, afflicted with grief."

verses.devanagari:
एतत्कुरु नरेन्ध्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन |
सत्यन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम्
verses.iast:
etatkuru narendhrasya vacanaṃ raghunandana |
satyana mahatā rāma tārayasva nareśvaram
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! Do as per the words of the king and liberate him by giving your father an opportunity to maintain the truth."

verses.devanagari:
इतीव तस्यां परुषम् वदन्त्याम् |
नचैव रामः प्रविवेश शोकम् |
प्रविव्यधे चापि महानुभावो |
राजा तु पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः
verses.iast:
itīva tasyāṃ paruśham vadantyām |
nacaiva rāmaḥ praviveśa śokam |
pravivyadhe cāpi mahānubhāvo |
rājā tu putravyasanābhitaptaḥ
verses.translation: Though she was speaking such harsh words, Rama was not affected with sorrow. But the mighty Dasaratha became highly disturbed, having been afflicted by the calamity occurred to his son.

glosses.meaning: become much disturbed putravyasanaabhitaptaH = having been afflicted by calamity occured to hi son.
